audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do blob transactions have between 1 and BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT blobs?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Prysm is a consensus layer (CL) client. Transaction validation (check_transaction, blob_versioned_hashes) is execution layer (EL) functionality. This property references EL-specific transaction processing that is not implemented in consensus clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are blob and SetCode transactions prevented from creating contracts?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Prysm is a consensus layer (CL) client. Transaction type validation (blob transactions, SetCode transactions, tx.to) is execution layer (EL) functionality not present in consensus clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do SetCode transactions require non-empty authorization lists?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Prysm is a consensus layer (CL) client. SetCode transaction validation (EIP-7702 authorization list) is execution layer (EL) functionality not implemented in consensus clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does sender nonce match transaction nonce exactly?
audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Prysm is a consensus layer (CL) client. Transaction nonce validation (sender_account.nonce vs tx.nonce) is execution layer (EL) state management not handled by consensus clients.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Prysm is a consensus layer (CL) client. Account deletion via SELFDESTRUCT and state trie management (accounts_to_delete) is execution layer (EL) functionality not present in consensus clients.
